summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an agreement with its largest shareholder, Vereniging Aegon (18.4% stake), to reform governance ahead of a planned US relocation. Terms include converting Vereniging's Common Shares B into common stock on a 1:40 basis, eliminating staggered board by 2030, and adopting majority voting. Vereniging will rename to Vereniging Aegon Americas, retaining its stake, while donating EUR 500 million to a new Dutch charity. The board supports the proposal. Aegon will engage shareholders after its June 10, 2026 AGM. Watch for shareholder and proxy advisor reaction to the governance overhaul and relocation timeline.
